name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.3 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 4 visits over 11 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 16 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 11 hours starting 2026-07-17, at wavelengths from 1.72 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
